response.sql: WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM eq), grp AS (SELECT AVG(eq.avg_hum) AS group_avg FROM eq, overall WHERE eq.avg_hum > overall.overall_avg) SELECT eq.equipref AS equipment_reference, eq.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, eq.avg_hum - overall.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg, eq.avg_hum - grp.group_avg AS diff_from_group_mean FROM eq, overall, grp WHERE overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND grp.group_avg IS NOT NULL AND eq.avg_hum > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY (eq.avg_hum - grp.group_avg) IS NULL, (eq.avg_hum - grp.group_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
